task: Fix portal/v1.1.0 sign job receiving digest null: producer uses a key imagetools does not write; validate at producer and consumer; add recovery dispatch

events.summary: Only portal-docker-publish.yml, one new unit test, the lessons-log row and this trace change. Signing key/secret handling and cosign flags are untouched.

Run 38747268314: merge job step 'Create manifest list and push' wrote digest=$(jq -r '.["containerimage.digest"]' manifest-metadata.json); sign job then ran cosign sign on IMAGE@null (could not parse reference). The index digest the registry holds is sha256:16e228757febda1b7649ce2ee79908f30a70ba41648943987fe26831d88ac30a, confirmed by docker buildx imagetools inspect --format '{{.Manifest.Digest}}' ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.0.

Merge job reads the digest from the registry for the first pushed tag and validates sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}; sign job gains a 'Validate image digest' step before cosign and passes DIGEST through env; workflow_dispatch input sign_digest signs an existing digest with build/merge skipped. New unit test fails on the old workflow and passes on the new one.
